title: Fixture review policy — Acme University affiliation (SYNTHETIC)
description: Synthetic policy for the OPF 0.3 gold fixture. Fictional parties and positions only; it exists so tests and the acceptance harness exercise the real policy path end to end without touching any real playbook. Mirrors the shape of a production policy: a floor of binding `must` rules plus weighted `should` dispositions.

approval.note: Synthetic fixture policy — approved so tests can exercise the approved path.

rules.text: This agreement type is generally low-risk. Default toward ACCEPT.
If two reasonable formulations of the same standard concept exist, accept the counterparty's wording rather than insist on ours.
Use corpus precedent as internal evidence only. Never quote counterparty names, deal dates, or precedent language in external-facing comments or redlines.
Do not accept uncapped or unlimited liability, or an indemnity covering the counterparty's own negligence.
Do not accept general or one-way indemnification by us. Narrow mutual negligence-based indemnification is an acceptable variation and does not violate this rule.
Do not accept removal of the standard confidentiality exceptions.
Governing law is negotiable: concede the counterparty's home-state law where no exclusive forum-selection clause is added.
